sources.title: jensjepsen/danish-lm-400m-base-ropext2048-v1 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: RoPE-extended (512 → 2048 context) continuation of jensjepsen/danish-lm-400m-base-ckpt310k. Same architecture, same weights initialized from the base, then continued pretraining for ~160M tokens with rope_theta bumped from 10,000 → 500,000 and max_position_embeddings bumped from 512 → 2048.

sources.title: jensjepsen/danish-lm-400m-sft-v5 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: 400M-param Danish LM, SFT'd on a 9-source mix. Successor to danish-lm-400m-sft-v4 — same base, same optimizer, only change is upgrading the instruction-following dataset from IF-v1 → IF-v2 (150 render variants, 5-way combos, held-out eval).

sources.title: Empero — Independent AI Research Lab
sources.snippet: Empero is an independent AI research lab in Germany building small, efficient language models you can own and run yourself. 1M+ downloads on Hugging Face. Qwythos-9B-v2, Qwythos-27B-v1, and Abacus — open weights, open code, open datasets.
